title: More is Less: The Pitfalls of Multi-Model Synthetic Preference Data in DPO Safety Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity and fairness of model outputs using the TOXIGEN dataset, which contains statements across 13 minority identity groups (e.g., African Americans, women, LGBTQ+ individuals). The model outputs were scored on a 1-5 Toxic-Score scale using GPT-4o as an automated judge.
